sense.text:
“For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.” We are supposed to go into the scriptures to find comfort in whatever we are going through. Whatever trials and tribulations come, we find the answers in the scriptures.

That is what separates the men and women gathered on the Sabbath from the so-called Christians, who do not rely on the Bible for their understanding or their faith. What is in the world today is a social religion, more like a superstition for our people: they do not really believe the words of God, they believe what society told them to do. Israel relies on the scriptures and believes on the Lord according as it is written. The topic is one mind, one body.

“Hear, O Israel: The Lord our God is one Lord.” Start with the order first: the Lord our God is one Lord. “And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul.”

So we start off with one Lord. And if the Lord is one, what does the body have to be? One, in unison, in sync. That is why this body, this congregation, has been able to accomplish the amazing things it has: because it is one.

precepts.why:
Christ said, “I and my Father are one.” There is no division between Christ and his Father; they are on one accord.

The Lord our God is one Lord, and the Son is one with the Father. That is the pattern of oneness the body has to follow.

sense.text:
“At that day ye shall know that I am in my Father, and ye in me, and I in you.” Here Christ is warning of his departure, that he would leave and not be there physically in the body. At that day his people would come to the understanding of what it means: he is in his Father, they are in him, and he is in them.

Christ does what his Father tells him to do, then he comes down and tells us what to do, and we keep those commandments. That is how we are in him and he in us. Christ said that we would be one.

“He that hath my commandments, and keepeth them, he it is that loveth me.” The commandments we are supposed to have are the Father’s commandments, all of them. No picking and choosing, cherry-picking, hopping and skipping around like the Christians. Everything the Father told us to do, those are the commandments, and the man or woman that keeps them is the one that loves Christ, that loves the Lord.

“And he that loveth me shall be loved of my Father, and I will love him, and will manifest myself to him.” Here he is explaining the manifestation, how you receive the Holy Spirit. In order to have the Holy Spirit, you must be one with the Most High God and his Son.

precepts.why:
“I can of mine own self do nothing: as I hear, I judge.” As he hears, as he is told, that is what he does. “And my judgment is just”: the things he does are justified, “because I seek not mine own will, but the will of the Father which hath sent me.” He did not do what he wanted to do; he did what the Father told him to do.

You see how that works. Christ does not do what he wants; he does what the Father tells him. Yet the scripture says he and his Father are one. That is the oneness: not two wills, one. And Christ said that we would be one in the same way, which is why it goes straight back to John 14:20.

“As thou hast sent me into the world, even so have I also sent them into the world.” The them that Christ sent into the world are the apostles. “And for their sakes I sanctify myself, that they also might be sanctified through the truth.”

“Neither pray I for these alone, but for them also which shall believe on me through their word.” Through their word, through their teaching, through the apostles spreading this gospel, which is why we have the word today. He was praying for us as well.

“That they all may be one; as thou, Father, art in me, and I in thee, that they also may be one in us.” Then: “And the glory which thou gavest me I have given them; that they may be one, even as we are one.” Even as the Most High God and his Son are one. Where does that leave any room for that trinity doctrine nonsense? None.

It shows that we also are to be one with the Lord, the same oneness of John 14:20, I in my Father, ye in me, and I in you. And for us to be one, we must move in the spirit of one: one mind, one body.

sense.text:
“For as the body is one, and hath many members, and all the members of that one body, being many, are one body: so also is Christ.” A body is made of different parts that all work together: the heart that gives blood to the body, the brain that helps you think, the arms and legs that help you move. There are many parts in the functioning of a body.

Israel United in Christ is not many bodies. IUIC Austin, IUIC OKC, Atlanta, Arkansas: many members, but not different bodies. One body, the same, in the same mind and the same spirit. Regardless of where you travel or where you go, it should have the same feel, the same vibes, the same teachings, because we are one.

precepts.why:
“There is one body, and one Spirit, even as ye are called in one hope of your calling.” There are not multiple ways. I don’t care what Oprah said: there are not different ways, not different types, not different forms of God and how to worship God. There is only one way, one truth, and to be in alignment with it you must be doing exactly what the body is supposed to be doing: keeping the commandments and faith in his Son.

That is what brought us together. If anybody is here just for the fellowship, for friendships and relationships, you are in the wrong place. This is a conglomerate of brothers and sisters who decided to do what God said to do against all odds, against all the influences in the world telling us otherwise. We don’t care to be different and we don’t care if you look at us funny.

“One Lord, one faith, one baptism, One God and Father of all, who is above all, and through all, and in you all.” It keeps coming right back to that soundness, that unity, that oneness we have in Christ. Anybody teaching anything other than that don’t belong in here. There is no separatism in the nation, no separatism in the body of Christ. We are all one.

sense.text: “For other foundation can no man lay than that is laid, which is Jesus Christ.” Remember what got us to where we are. It started with only three families keeping the Passover together, with no garments, three-piece suits, unleavened bread, a lamb, bitter herbs and wine. The bishops would serve all the people at Passover, dishing out the lamb themselves: that is where humility was learned. Things had to change because of expansion and growth, and the changes were not comfortable, but they were necessary to bring us where we are today, one mind, one body, one spirit, understanding the mission.

“Now if any man build upon this foundation gold, silver, precious stones, wood, hay, stubble; Every man’s work shall be made manifest.” Do you understand what this body was built on? Other organizations started building before Israel United in Christ, with far more members and far more resources. But look at the outcomes today: no growth, no expansion, no change. Every man’s work is made manifest.

What made IUIC so different is the commandments. What did God give Moses to give us? Not the Catholic religion, not Islam: all his commandments.

precepts.why:
“The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom: a good understanding have all they that do his commandments.” Learn it early in this truth: if they are not keeping the commandments, they can’t teach you nothing.

Back in 2006 there were all the camps, and everybody was doing YouTube videos. Bishop Nathanyel’s videos weren’t getting hits like that because they weren’t the conspiracy theory stuff. Others taught that 9/11 was an inside job, showed you the back of the dollar bill, FEMA camp doctrine, plastic coffins at Walmart. Camps outside teaching with a whole beanie on, coffee steaming off the cup on the Lord’s Sabbath, trying to tell you the white man’s the damn devil and you need to join a school.

Meanwhile, how do you get to the kingdom? How do I make my marriage better, deal with my wife and my kids, be a better brother? What’s the plan? None of that was being taught. The Nathanyel 7 page separated many so-called teachers from those that actually fear God and understood the mission. A good understanding belongs to them that do his commandments.

“Where there is no vision, the people perish.” In the older camps there was no direction. Some brothers just went to the streets to talk crazy to white folks and at women as they walked by. Where has that gotten them today? Who grew a congregation over hating the black woman, hating the white man and all the other nations? Whose congregation is thriving with that as the basis of their teaching?

That is every man’s work made manifest: without vision, the people perish.

“And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.” Roll with those that have decided to turn against the ways of the world and not be conformed to what the world wants them to be, those that have understanding, because a good understanding have all they that do his commandments.

You know you are in the right place when you are surrounded by men and women who decided to put everything else behind them and not be conformed to this present world, who decided to do what God said, fashionable or not. At one time fringes weren’t fashionable; now everybody’s mama wants fringes. At one time it wasn’t fashionable for women to be in a dress, fully covered in modest apparel, and they said you were oppressing the women. No: we are giving them what God said.

“Therefore whosoever heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them, I will liken him unto a wise man, which built his house upon a rock.” These sayings of mine are Christ’s words. What did Christ say? If you love me, keep my commandments. And anybody teaching against keeping the commandments is going to be least in the kingdom of heaven.

This is what has been done here: this house, this congregation, this organization has been built on Christ, on the laws of God and faith in Christ. Surround yourself with those that decided to build on the proper foundation, which is why you are here as well.

Look at the back of your shirts: this body was built on the faith in Christ and the commandments of God. “Here is the patience of the saints: here are they that keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.”

Is there any other way to build? Can you be successful any other way? No. The commandments of God and the faith of Jesus is the foundation that is laid.

“Except the Lord build the house, they labour in vain that build it.” Build any other type of way and it is going to fall. A lot of organizations are finding out what happens when you try to build on anything other than the Lord. You built your whole congregation on fear. Y’all scared as hell. You thought the judgment was coming, 2012 was it, and you ran to Egypt: brothers got their passports, not to go teach but to try to deliver themselves, and literally left Babylon and landed in a civil war, talking about safety and security. Get the hell out of here. We are not built like that. This foundation is built on the rock, and that is why this body has had the success it has had.

“Except the Lord keep the city, the watchman waketh but in vain.” Except the Lord is behind it, it is going to fall.

Black people have the attitude that we can’t build nothing for ourselves, that the other nations, especially the white man, have to get involved for us to be successful. The bishops always taught to make sure we have our own and never depend on nobody, because the enemy can shut you down any time. Nobody is backing us; we don’t need anybody to back us up, we need each other. Together we can move mountains. The secret is keeping the laws. As long as we stand in the spirit, the Most High God is going to bless us and you will see the growth, and this is just the beginning.

Another camp asked how IUIC is able to set up schools in different states and countries all over the world. We keep the commandments and faith in Christ. The Lord is not going to increase you and bring the believers in if you are not the ones that give the understanding; if you ain’t been sent, he ain’t sending nobody to you. That is why we must endeavor to keep the unity.

sense.text:
“But now hath God set the members every one of them in the body, as it hath pleased him.” God organizes the body. God is who made us great. The reason this body is at the forefront, considered the vanguards, is because God appointed it to be. If we don’t see ourselves in that light and move any differently than that mindset, God will remove us and put somebody else there.

As it pleased him: each and every one of you was gathered here together for a purpose, for a reason, brought into this body to benefit the nation. For those that think you are insignificant, a regular Joe: God called you in here. You have a mission and a purpose, so you had better apply your gifts, your talents, to what God brought you in here to do. If you do anything other than that, you are going against God.

precepts.why:
“For as we have many members in one body, and all members have not the same office.” Why don’t all members have the same office? Because there are things in other offices that won’t get done, like traveling or the kitchen, if everyone is in one office. It is the body: the heart and the brain function in different things, but they all come together to make the body function as one.

The mind doesn’t have the same function as the hand; the hand doesn’t have the same function as the foot. Every member functions, but they all need each other. A body can’t function with all hands or all elbows; it is not complete. If everybody comes in trying to be the hands, or the feet, what happens? Disorder. Everybody can’t be the head, everybody can’t be the shoulders. Everybody has their function.

“Let all things be done decently and in order.” The Lord is about order. He is not going to bring the same member into the body over and over; he is not going to just keep on bringing in hands. He brings members for different functions.

Can everybody be a teacher? Then who is going to read? Can everybody be the one for camp? Change is coming: we have grown into a nation. There are many talents and gifts, especially among the sisters, that haven’t been tapped into yet. It has been looked at from a war perspective, and it is spiritual war outside, and brothers must be prepared to spread this gospel. But for the functioning of this body there are so many more things to prepare for, or we will stay stagnant like others have.

The bishops have taught for years: prepare, prepare, prepare. Most of the time it was food, but preparation is not in one spot only. We need lawyers, doctors, nurses, farmers. That is how a nation prepares. So go to school and get an education; don’t listen to bum Israelites saying don’t go to school because Christ is coming in ten years. That’s a bum mentality. The same brothers that told their congregants not to go to school cannot open one building to this day, because they ain’t got the funds; they taught their congregants not to achieve greatness. You are Israelites with the spirit of Christ on you: master any skill, any trade, learn AI, and bring that mastery back to benefit your nation. We don’t want no bums, brothers or sisters.

sense.text:
Bishop Yawasap has been preparing the body and teaching this for years, and Deacon Asaph taught it as well. Back in 2016 it was shown from this verse: the body is Israel under Christ. Original Royalty, the kitchen, the school with the kids, security, video, music: all of these are components in a society. Different parts, but it all works together for the common good of the whole nation. Ten years ago those offices were what was being set up; now it is old news. That is what vision does for a nation when there is leadership with vision given by God.

The other nations have people that build the buildings, others that teach in school, others that drive the trucks, but they all believe in their own history and come together for what they believe in. An architect doesn’t do the same thing as an electrician, a teacher doesn’t do the same thing as a bus driver, yet they will all come out in the street and support it. That is what we are: one good in Original Royalty, one in filming, one at teaching the scriptures, but all linked together because we all keep these commandments. When a brother in one field falls low, we all support him.

“For by one Spirit are we all baptized into one body.” That spirit is the laws and Christ, and we are Israelites who come together for that one body. “Whether we be Jews”: whether you grew up knowing who you were, under the Levitical order; “or Gentiles”: or you were of the diaspora, the scattered, calling yourself after different names, Greek names. “Whether we be bond or free; and have been all made to drink into one Spirit.”

“For the body is not one member, but many”: different parts of the body. “If the foot shall say, Because I am not the hand, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?” And the ear that is not the eye is still of the body. “If the whole body were an eye, where were the hearing?”

“But now hath God set the members every one of them in the body, as it hath pleased him.” Just like your body, God gave you every member, every limb, every part of your body for a reason. What part of your body do you not need? Lose your pinky toe and see if you walk the same, see if you don’t feel off. God gave you all your members for a reason.

All of us were put in here for a reason, for a purpose. Nobody should be trying to bog down your talent or your gifts or make you stagnant. We should want to accentuate those gifts, further them, and teach others those talents if it be possible.
“And if they were all one member, where were the body? But now are they many members, yet but one body.” One body, one mind, one spirit.

precepts.why:
The Lord is not the author of confusion; he is of order. When he brings in different talents, different gifts, different members, he brings them in for a purpose that all serves the same thing, with different functions. That is you, that is me, that is all of us. All the teachers don’t focus on the same things: some on prophecy, some on organization structure, some on marriage. Even among the deacons you can see each one’s specialty and know where to go to learn and glean.

“And he gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers.” Some people’s offices were to be apostles, some prophets, some evangelists, pastors and teachers. “For the perfecting of the saints”: all of it was for one goal. Though they had different offices and administrations, it was “for the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry, for the edifying of the body of Christ: Till we all come in the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, unto a perfect man, unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ.”

All of these members, all of these offices have a purpose: to bring us to where we need to be. What office can we say we don’t need? Think like that and you are not nation building; you ain’t been given the vision. Bum camps said don’t worry about doing anything with the videos, just play them, not realizing the world we live in. The video needs music, an intro, to be made alluring, so that somebody on the outside will say, let me look at this, and once the scriptures start hitting, they know who they are. Many came in like that. It is the effort put into it, because the Lord knows what is necessary.

sense.text:
“As every man hath received the gift, even so minister the same one to another.” Shame on you if you come in here and sit on your hands, sit on the talent God has given you, and don’t put forth or show effort. If you have a craft or something to offer and you don’t come in here trying to show it and help, shame on you. You have been given that for a reason.

“As good stewards of the manifold grace of God.” Your job is to utilize that gift and benefit your nation.

precepts.why:
“A man’s gift maketh room for him, and bringeth him before great men.” When you have a talent, when you are able to do something for the nation, at least come in and say, I’m able to do this. It may be lined up for later, or it may be needed right now.

When the building in OKC was first gotten around 2017, it was trash: downed wires, mold, fiberglass floating. Brothers started coming out the woodwork, and one said, I’m a carpenter, I build. He came in, looked around, and said that wire is a fire hazard. The Lord brought those people in so they could build up the school, and the moment it was completed, that same brother disappeared. He served his purpose. We have to utilize these gifts because it is necessary.

The parable of the talents: the talent is money, the understanding God bestows on you. “Then he which had received the one talent came and said, Lord, I knew thee that thou art an hard man, reaping where thou hast not sown, and gathering where thou hast not strawed: And I was afraid, and went and hid thy talent in the earth.” He didn’t do nothing with the understanding, the wisdom, the gift the Lord bestowed on him. He hid it.

Hear what Christ said: “Thou wicked and slothful servant.” “Thou oughtest therefore to have put my money to the exchangers, and then at my coming I should have received mine own with usury.” If you couldn’t do nothing with the talent, at least put it to the exchangers so he could reap something. “Take therefore the talent from him, and give it unto him which hath ten talents.”

A lot of people think their gift gives them job security. When you don’t utilize the gift God has given you in this truth, God will take that gift from you and put the spirit on somebody else to utilize it and take the truth even further. It has been seen time and time again: men and sisters with certain talents who hide them, or use them as, you can’t do this without me. Yes, this can be done without you. If you can’t be used, you are useless. But none of you are useless: we all have a purpose, called for a reason, with something in you to give to build the nation.

sense.text:
God has given us different gifts, different offices, but the same mission. Teacher, organizer, counselor, building with your hands, security: if you have experience in anything that could benefit the nation, you are here for a purpose. “For I say, through the grace given unto me, to every man that is among you, not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think.” Stay humble. We are all expendable; we can all be replaced if we don’t use our talent.

What happens when someone thinks more highly than they ought to? Think from the mind frame of a member. Because you are the knuckle, you think, I keep us safe, I’m better than everybody else. You start to think you are more important than another member and forget that all the members are just as important. When members think they are more important than another, dysfunction comes into the body, and members start treating other offices like they are less important.

Where would we be without security? Unsafe. Without the brothers that clean the toilets, the kitchen, the floors? Infested with roaches and mice. Without the kitchen? Hungry; some single brothers look forward to the Sabbath because they actually get a real meal and not the peanut butter and jelly. The Lord has brought all these administrations together so we can function, and not one is more important. Even in leadership: a deacon is not better than you; he could die tomorrow and be the devil. I gotta keep the commandments, you gotta keep the commandments; I gotta believe on Christ, you gotta believe on Christ. No difference. Don’t treat folks like celebrities. When I go to pay my gas bill, nobody says that’s Deacon; they say, Nigga, I had to come shut your stuff off for you to come see me.

If you start to think you are better because of an office, the body will suffer. Be a support for every office, every member, every function, and see the value in every last one: the sisters changing the diapers, the brother folding flyers who has probably put a million flyers into rotation in the earth. It may have been you that got one of them. “But to think soberly, according as God hath dealt to every man the measure of faith.”

precepts.why:
“Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory.” That spirit will unravel things, and people can see it when you move like that. Security brothers, be careful: you are able to tell people move here, move there, and you get ahead of yourself. That is your brother, that is your sister. Deal with one another like we are the same, the way you want to be dealt with. Some are hardheaded and you have to speak a certain way to let them know this needs to happen now, but no member is better than the next. We are all the same, working toward the same goal: we want the kingdom.

“But in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves.” With that mind frame we are going to move mountains.

sense.text:
“Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!” Why is it good and pleasant? Because it is the only way we are going to grow, keeping the commandments all together as a unit. Without unity it is going to be disorder, and nothing will be built. A nation divided shall fall, so we have to learn how to love to be amongst each other.

And the reason it is so important: we can’t be stopped when we are unified.

precepts.why:
“How should one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight.” Unity. That is how it will be done: through us together, unified in Christ. Hence the name Israel United in Christ. With that type of unity we can move mountains; without it, brothers, we won’t do nothing.

Look at some of the others: they don’t aspire to do anything, they are fine just where they are, doing videos from their garages. But the vision here has been set at a worldwide standard. If you don’t have worldwide aspirations, you are not going to do worldwide things. Think small and you will stay small. Shoot for the stars; we are going to the heavens with it.

The 60-man camp in 2013 set a standard in the nation: it showed you can organize, you can unify, and we can all be under one. Of those 60 men there ain’t many left. The Lord will bring you into this as a temporary soul, to temporarily do what he needs, and you will be discarded and someone who belongs there will take your stead, and the mission will continue without you. That is why a man should not think more highly of himself than he ought: the Lord don’t need not one of us; he will replace you. Today one phone call can bring a thousand men. Don’t tell me the Most High is not working with these men.

“Can two walk together, except they be agreed?” No. That is why what we have is so beautiful. Individuals have risen up disorderly, going against what the Lord has called, wanting to set up their own thing; they don’t like structure or order, or someone being over them; they want to be the head dude. What is unique about this body is that individuals understand order. Everybody can’t be the bishop, the deacons, the captains, the officers or soldiers, but everybody plays their part.

This congregation is built on men and women who aren’t worried about titles. A deacon, a bishop, a captain or an officer can be demoted to a brother and be the same way, because they are who they are. If the Lord gave you the spirit to teach, to unify, to exhort, you are going to utilize it; you will never give that up because it is who you are. Flattering titles only give you a name. Don’t let a title create who you are; you have to be who you are to get the title, with or without the name.

sense.text:
“Now there are diversities of gifts, but the same Spirit”: all under one. “And there are differences of administrations, but the same Lord”: all under the same thing. “And there are diversities of operations, but it is the same God which worketh all in all.”

Is that all talking about camp, camp, camp? No. At one time a camp was the brothers that go out in the streets and teach, but we have risen above that; we are more than street teaching now. Youth violence, Saving Sarah’s Daughters, community cleanups, prison ministry, the colleges, music, Original Royalty with its branches and even a modeling section. Back in the day there were two songs in rotation. Look what has been done in the spirit of Christ and his Father. The question is what we are going to do next. The sky is the limit.

“But the manifestation of the Spirit is given to every man to profit withal.” “For to one is given by the Spirit the word of wisdom; to another the word of knowledge by the same Spirit; To another faith by the same Spirit; to another the gifts of healing by the same Spirit; To another the working of miracles; to another prophecy; to another discerning of spirits; to another divers kinds of tongues; to another the interpretation of tongues.”

All these different gifts, but they are all for the same purpose: the perfecting of the saints, to profit the ministry, to build up the nation. You weren’t given the gift to hold on to it or keep it to yourself; you were given the gift so it could help somebody else.

“But all these worketh that one and the selfsame Spirit, dividing to every man severally as he will.” It has been divided, given to each member as the Lord saw fit.

Look what has been accomplished. We came out of the world, where Christmas was a big deal, eggnog and cartoons. Now there are children born in Israel United in Christ that have never known anything other than the high holy days of the Lord, and they get that feeling ten times more when the feast days and Passover come up. These grassroots sprouted into what we have today. From two families it has been exponential growth, and Israel United in Christ is simply an organizational name: the truth is about the nation of Israel, the gathering of the one third of the nation, and the vision has been the same from day one.

“Then they that gladly received his word were baptized: and the same day there were added unto them about three thousand souls. And they continued stedfastly in the apostles’ doctrine and fellowship, and in breaking of bread, and in prayers.” To have this mind, it has to come from the Lord. Look what the Lord has done with Israel United in Christ: thousands and thousands of brothers and sisters have come into repentance, learned who they are according to the Bible, and learned to keep God’s commandments and faith in his Son.

The Lord continues to increase this body because we never let go of the true mission, the true vision the Lord gave. Get sidetracked and he will destroy all this; we will look up and there will be nobody here. So we must remain focused, continue to grow as the Lord gives, and adjust.

“And fear came upon every soul: and many wonders and signs were done by the apostles. And all that believed were together, and had all things common.” This is the level of unity we have to get to. It is not that we haven’t made it here, but we can do a lot better: to have a common goal, all understand the mission, and all believe enough to give up whatever we have to give up to get it done.

precepts.why:
“And the multitude of them that believed were of one heart and of one soul: neither said any of them that ought of the things which he possessed was his own; but they had all things common.” What were they able to accomplish because their mindset was like this? Whatever they wanted to.

To have all things in common they had to give up certain things so that someone else could have, and so that they could have. They believed so much that they were able to do anything they wanted. There is great unity in this body, but we can go further than we have gone.

And it has been done on this level. Brothers came together and bought the building in New York, every one with more than one skill, sheetrocking, ceilings, bouncing from job to job. In 2023 the bishop said no more big Passovers for a while: collect money and buy property, because we need to have our own, no more anonymous phone calls about terrorists in the building getting us shut down, no more depending on Esau. Then came the land fund blitz, and the land was bought: 40 acres, phase one. Just as in Acts 2 and Acts 4, the offerings were placed at the leadership’s feet and distributed as there is need. Leadership paints the vision, but the execution happens through the faith and willingness of the whole body.

sense.text: “Where there is no vision, the people perish.” This is why leadership puts things in place. Thank the Lord for true leadership; there is nowhere else to be.

precepts.why: The scriptures tell us this is a global mission, worldwide. Aspirations and goals have to be set to a global standard, not a local one, not one individual city or place. “Ye are the light of the world.” Not of Brooklyn, not of one city: of the world. The Lord said we are a light of the world when he sent us out.

How are you the guys if you ain’t got global goals, if you ain’t touching the ends of the earth? “And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world.” How is it going to be preached in all of the world if you have no plans, no plan of action, no implementation to do anything worldwide? The Lord sent his prophets with vision, with goals, with aspirations to take it to the ends of the earth.

“For a witness unto all nations; and then shall the end come.”

“And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria, and from Egypt, and from Pathros, and from Cush, and from Elam, and from Shinar, and from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.” How are these people going to rise out of these places if they were never told? Because this gospel has to have a global standard, preached to the four corners of the world. If your leadership ain’t talking about covering the earth, they are not the guys. Don’t waste your time.

We don’t give a damn how anybody feels about it. They ridicule us: y’all going over there to Africa, India, Australia, Papua New Guinea. You do err, not knowing the scriptures. The people have been scattered to the four corners; how are you going to reach them if your aspiration is just down the street, Times Square, a street corner? Where would we be today if this truth had never left the streets of Harlem and Brooklyn? Where a lot of these other camps are. Look at the grand openings: Kansas City, Virginia, the 13th school. Now there is damn near a school in every city in Babylon, and the talk is worldwide congregations.

sense.text:
It is very important we follow instructions. “Now I beseech you, brethren, by the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye all speak the same thing, and that there be no divisions among you; but that ye be perfectly joined together in the same mind and in the same judgment.”

When a brother, Officer Mabz, was shot in St. Louis, brothers were of the same mind, the same spirit: they touched one of our own, so I’ve got to be in the building to support. We have to be like that in everything: show up and support each other, every congregation, international or in a different country. It is going to take that level of dedication to move to the next level.

Many seen in the old videos are long gone: temporary souls brought in for temporary purposes. Make sure you ain’t temporary. Don’t be that lost soul; be the soul that came in and is still here, enduring.

This is to the leaders, dealing with the different offices and administrations: you must know your men. “And we beseech you, brethren, to know them which labour among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you.” In a position of leadership you have to know the different talents brothers have, which means paying attention to the spirits in your school. Be able to spot them and utilize those brothers, especially when they show you what they are good at or you observe it.

You will have a soul in your school with a talent, a gift, and if you as an administrator are not utilizing them, it keeps you all in the same spot. Sometimes all the answers are right there among you, and you think you have to venture out when you have everything you need in the congregation with you.

“And to esteem them very highly in love for their work’s sake.” Take the spirit of exhortation: you have to understand these spirits and place them in the right places, because they will build up other brothers.

Because the body came together, IUIC got its own channel on Roku, and the haters came out saying they sold out. They don’t understand the power of God or the spirit of Christ that is on each one who said, we are going to put our money where our faith is and make great things happen.

“Though thy beginning was small, yet thy latter end should greatly increase.” In 2006 IUIC wasn’t the most revered or loved camp, school or YouTube page. The Nathanyel 7 page wasn’t the grandest; other Israelites doing videos got far more views because of the shock content, black men in the streets telling an Edomite woman she’s the damn devil. The views were small, but the content changed lives. The content drew people, because it was what we needed as a people.

Look at us now. This body has grown because there were people who understood what was necessary for the nation and what we needed to grow as a people. It took true vision and true dedication, and it was done together. It is not a one-man show. The booster club is how boots are put on the ground all over the world: one same mind and same spirit, and the one who can’t be there physically gives so others can go and make it happen.

The bishops had already seen it. This body is sincere about bringing the truth to the people, with no ulterior motive and a sincere love for our people, who need the medicine the Most High has in that Bible. Other congregations gave up the fight and don’t want anyone to show them up. What separated this body from the other Israelite groups is going into the law and using precepts, not pushing what is not there: a six-pointed star, the need to learn Hebrew or call the name to be saved, while our people are on drugs, shooting, killing, raping and robbing each other, husbands not knowing how to be husbands, wives not knowing how to be wives, kids out of order. The focus here was the family, instilling morals, principles and values, teaching men how to be brothers. The Most High didn’t cast us out because we forgot his language; we knew Hebrew when he cast us out. We fell because we are ungodly men, and we must take responsibility and keep the law before he will accept us again.

The separation was made long ago, and it was the Lord that did it; we are just the ones that decided to do what he said. When the Lord said, be ye separate, it means just that: this body cannot be affiliated with any nonsense, because it is too important.
“But speaking the truth in love, may grow up into him in all things, which is the head, even Christ.” This is still speaking about the body. Christ is truly the head of this body.

“From whom the whole body fitly joined together and compacted by that which every joint supplieth.” This body has been purposely put together; there are no coincidences here. How are there so many talented brothers here? Because God has a plan.

“According to the effectual working in the measure of every part, maketh increase of the body unto the edifying of itself in love.” In love: this is the increase. The reason this body moves the way it moves is because we get it. You get it, I get it, and this is what it is going to take to go further in this truth.

We have to move as one, not separately, not as individual entities: one mind, one body. Look at what has been done, and think about what is going to be done; we are just getting started. “Therefore we ought to give the more earnest heed to the things which we have heard, lest at any time we should let them slip.”
